scope: Browser UI checks with intercepted API fixtures. No model calls or persisted application mutations.
checks: Initial selected row has an aligned bubble
Bubble visibly travels down the navigation
Selected navigation is exposed to assistive technology
Bubble visibly travels back up
Rapid route changes settle on the final selection
Search dialog opens without moving the current section
Keyboard navigation uses the same active bubble
Keyboard focus remains visible
Dynamically rendered actions receive click feedback
Details panel opens with its real action
Disabled send control has no click effects
Sending feedback follows the actual pending request
Failed send restores the control and preserves text
Upload shows a loader and blocks duplicate clicks
Successful upload restores the attachment control
Failed upload restores the control and reports the error
Project creation blocks duplicate submission
Leaving main categories hides the bubble
Runtime check has an honest pending label
Runtime check restores its label
Mobile starts with a collapsed sidebar
Mobile selection closes navigation
Bubble realigns when mobile navigation reopens
Bubble realigns after desktop resize
Reduced motion cancels navigation and page animations
Reduced motion also disables dialog and ripple effects
No horizontal document overflow at 320px
No browser JavaScript errors
All mutations were isolated to UI fixtures
